title: Citation Record
description: Attached to every retrievable unit and to every knowledge-grounded answer. Makes 'every number traces to a source' verifiable post-hoc; the audit log stores these records. Extends src/agent/safety.py's assumptions_cited so cited ids resolve to a registered document.

doc_id.description: Must resolve to an active corpus_manifest.yaml or dataset_manifest.yaml id

chunk_ref.description: chunk_id (doc_id + ordinal) or section_ref for the specific unit cited

page_paragraph.description: Page / paragraph / clause / obligation id for the exact location

retrieved_at.description: When the unit was retrieved, so the citation records the version in force at answer time
